_comment: Maximum allowed ratio of PureFIT median time to Garmin SDK median time, per scenario. Below 1.0 means PureFIT is faster. Ratios are used instead of absolute timings because both libraries run on the same CI machine and absorb the same runner noise, which absolute thresholds cannot. Budgets carry deliberate headroom over locally measured ratios (~0.79 / ~0.49 / ~0.90) so the gate catches real regressions rather than variance.
